The '''1977–78 [[Super League Greece|Alpha Ethniki]]''' was the 42nd season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league of Greece. The season began on 11 September 1977 and ended on 28 May 1978. [[AEK Athens F.C.|AEK Athens]] won their sixth Greek title and their first one in seven years.

The point system was: ''Win: 2 points'' - ''Draw: 1 point''.
